'''Talon of [[Izax]]''' was the name of an [[Eternal Empire Walker]] walker used during the [[war against Zakuul]]. During the [[Invasion of Voss]] in [[3630 BBY]], the walker was deployed on the battlefield near the [[Shrine of Healing]], but was destroyed by an [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] walker named [[Storm Rider]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talon of Izax appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during '''"Chapter I: Wrath and Ruin"'''.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
